# `firearms.client.ui` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

The weapon, attachment and cartridge tooltips (WeaponTooltip, `docs/spec/domains/ui.md` `UI-REQ-001`): every number formatted through StatsText's Locale.ROOT helpers, mirroring create_metered_motor's own StatsText/MeteredMotorTooltip split.

### `class StatsText` — `src/main/java/firearms/client/ui/StatsText.java`
Number formatting shared by every WeaponTooltip line, mirroring create_metered_motor's own StatsText: every value goes through Locale#ROOT so a client's own locale never turns a decimal point into a comma mid-tooltip.
- `String oneDecimal(double value)` — One decimal place, e.g.
- `String whole(int value)` — A whole number, e.g.
- `String percentChange(double factor)` — A multiplicative Modifier's own factor as a signed percentage change, e.g.
- `String signed(double value)` — An additive Modifier's own raw amount, signed, e.g.

### `class WeaponTooltip` — `src/main/java/firearms/client/ui/WeaponTooltip.java`
The weapon, attachment and cartridge tooltips (`docs/spec/domains/ui.md` `UI-REQ-001`, §3): a weapon stack's own name and class, its nine live-derived stats, every slot its class shows (occupied or "unequipped"), and its loaded ammo vs.
- `void register()`
- `List<Component> lines(ItemStack stack)` — The tooltip lines for stack: an attachment item's own slot and modifiers, a cartridge item's own calibre, or a weapon item's own name, class, nine derived stats, every class slot's occupant or "unequipped," and its ammo line — recomputed fresh from stack's own current components every call, never cached (`UI-REQ-001`).
